subject: Oceanography
title: Penguins
description: A quick, practical guide to Penguins.

hook.text: Emperor penguins breed in Antarctica during winter—in total darkness at −60°C with 200 km/h winds.

buildup.text: Males incubate the egg on their feet for 65 days—starving while females hunt at sea.

discovery.text: Penguins' dense feathers trap air for insulation—and counter-current blood flow keeps their feet from freezing.

twist.text: Adélie penguin populations are shifting south as warming moves their preferred habitat poleward.

climax.text: In 2022, emperor penguin breeding colonies failed for the first time—sea ice broke up before chicks could fledge.

punchline.text: The toughest birds on Earth are running out of ice.

quiz.question: Why did emperor penguin colonies fail in 2022?
options: Sea ice broke up before chicks were ready
